ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced Technical Writer to create and maintain user documentation across our diverse business lines. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of our products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Technical Writer, your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts. 

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate complex hardware and software systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well-written and presented artifacts. 

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. You will engage subject matter experts at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format. 

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available. 

Along with our commercial offerings outlined above, Anduril is pursuing Programs with the GOV, which require documentation in standards such as MIL-STD-40051D and S1000D, delivered via IETMs / IETDs. Familiarity with these standards and delivery methods is highly desired. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with engineering and operations to deliver task, conditions, and standard-centric documentation.
  • Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and considering input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions.
  • Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time and shared with leadership.
  • Help build a culture of technical documentation by contributing to the living documentation process, ensuring that those who come after you learn from your acquired Anduril experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of demonstrated excellence generating technical documentation for complex hardware, software, or aerospace systems.
  • Experience writing technical, user-facing documentation.
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation (e.g., schematics, CAD, or software specs).
  • Experience building content in a variety of formats (Word, XML, DITA, etc.).
  • Strong written/verbal communication and interpersonal skills, with an emphasis on explaining highly technical subjects simply.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. security clearance.
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local, to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (MIL-STD-40051, S1000D, etc.).
  • Passion for excellent documentation and user experience.
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation in Aerospace and Defense (for DoD).
  • Experience delivering content on fast-paced, complex projects with multiple stakeholders.

ABOUT THE JOB 

As a Technical Writer, your mission is to partner with our numerous product and operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.
With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “arsenal of democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally well written and presented artifacts.
You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst with 2–5 years of experience in corporate cash management and banking operations. You will run our day-to-day global treasury operations. Operating in a high-volume, multi-currency environment, you will be responsible for hands-on execution of daily cash positioning, payment processing, and bank portal administration across our banking and financial institution relationships.

The role demands precision and control discipline to safeguard Anduril's cash. You will play an integral part in the Treasury Management System implementation process and ultimately be responsible for its day-to-day management post go-live. This position reports to the Treasury Lead.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage and execute daily global cash positioning across our legal entities and multiple currencies, ensuring adequate funding for daily operations with recommendation of daily short term investment redemption/investment activities
    • Prepare and initiate daily domestic and international wire transfers, ACH payments, and intercompany funding movements.
    • Process multi-currency notional cash pooling and FX trade settlements.
    • Act as the primary processor for corporate debt/revolver drawdowns, interest payments, and short-term yield investments.
    • Perform daily bank reconciliations and coordinate cash application with Accounting.
    • Support the compilation and variance analysis of the short-term cash flow forecast.
  • Bank Account Administration & Controls
    • Maintain Anduril's global bank account inventory, supporting account opening and closing workflows in multiple jurisdictions.
    • Coordinate the gathering and submission of Know Your Customer (KYC) documentation and bank account signer updates.
    • Manage user access across banking platforms – granting access and entitlements to new users as well as deactivating users immediately upon employee termination.
  • Treasury Systems & Project Support
    • Partner with cross-functional teams on the implementation of the automated Treasury Management System (TMS).
    • Manage Bloomberg terminal maintenance and user administration.
    • Maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for daily cash operations and banking configurations.
  • Compliance & Audit Support
    • Gather bank statements, signatory lists, and bank audit confirmation letters for internal and external auditors.
    • Support month-end close with cash, interest, and bank fee reconciliations and related journal entries.
    • Support SOX and internal-control walkthroughs and testing for treasury processes. 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2–5 years of progressive, hands-on experience in corporate treasury operations, cash positioning, or commercial banking.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, standard formulas, pivot tables).
    • Experience in navigating and initiating transactions within global banking portals.
    • Direct hands-on experience with treasury management systems (FIS, GTreasury/Ripple, Kyriba, or similar); familiarity with ERP systems (Oracle Fusion, SAP, or similar) is a plus. 
  • Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Certification: Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), or active progress toward it.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving: Exceptional quantitative skills with meticulous attention to detail; able to spot cash discrepancies and bank transmission issues quickly.
  • Security & Control Focus: High integrity with a firm understanding of segregation of duties, security policies, and internal control frameworks.
  • Adaptability: Ability to maintain operational accuracy under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while shifting from manual processes to automated system modules.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate cross-functionally.

Anduril’s Mission Success team is a cross-functional group that partners with every business line and supports all products that Anduril builds. Our responsibilities include product operations, training and adoption, and user documentation. We are seeking an experienced senior technical writer to lead high-profile and demanding programs for our government customers. We believe that the quality of our documentation should reflect the quality of products, which are world-class.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Technical Writer, your mission is to partner with our Product and Operations teams to deliver accurate, updated, and easy-to-understand documentation on how to use Anduril products. You will do whatever it takes to organize our engineering and program delivery functions in this mission. In this role, you will work closely with Engineering, Operations, and various subject matter experts to understand our products, identify user workflows, and use documentation to close the gap. As such, the Technical Writer will play a foundational role in setting the bar for tone, voice, and quality across our written artifacts.

With Anduril’s focus on defense and national security, user documentation plays a critical role in ensuring front-line operators know how to leverage the “Arsenal of Democracy.” Your mission is to make the process of learning how to operate systems as easy and seamless as possible, with exceptionally written and presented artifacts.

You will identify relevant stakeholders and lead them through a documentation roadmap with established key milestones and targets. This will require an in-depth understanding of what teams are relevant to documentation, and what an organized effort toward collaboration, entails. You are to ensure that stakeholders are engaged at the right time, and you will guide them towards a finished user-facing document that plainly meets customer needs. Finally, you will work with our account teams to ensure that contract deliverables are accurate, on-time, and in the right format.

Written content artifacts under this charter may include things like: technical manuals, operational manuals, maintenance manuals, procedures, checklists, templates, user guides, troubleshooting guides, and release notes. You will partner with account, product, and engineering teams across all phases of product development to ensure users have the right documentation available.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Generate, review, and edit documentation that is user-focused. Work with Engineering and Operations to deliver task, conditions, standard-centric documentation
  • Research Anduril products and scope Tech Data deliverables for Programs of Record with DOD customers, and write Data Modules in Mil-Std-40051-E XML, using Raytheon Eagle (eventually migrating to Rapid Author)
  • Evaluate and prioritize tasks required to successfully support product documentation efforts and keep them on track. Help drive the best decision for the company by using a data-driven approach and consider input from stakeholders to ensure well-informed decisions. You should be prepared to fill gaps that represent risks to the documentation roadmap
  • Communicate and help manage expectations. Ensure risks are noted with adequate time, mitigations are identified, and resources are allocated
  • Help build a culture of technical documentation by creating process and training for others to contribute content. Refine our product maturity framework so that documentation is a meaningful step towards productization of new systems

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of demonstrated excellence generating XML-based technical documentation, preferably in a DOD space
  • Experience reading and interpreting engineering documentation
  • Experience building MIL-STD-40051 content (preferably using RTX Eagle)
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills, with emphasis on technical subjects
  • Must thrive with autonomy and responsibility, managing competing priorities and tight deadlines. Impeccable project-management skills
  • Passion for excellent documentation and user experience
  • Must be eligible for Secret and higher security clearance (US)
  • Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA
  • In this role, you will be subject to pre-employment and randomized substance screening, as required by the Company.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Military exposure and experience, particularly with military technical documentation writing and formatting standards, guidelines, and verbiage (S1000D, MIL-STD-40051, etc)
  • Previous experience creating technical documentation for DOD products
  • Experience with Siemens Rapid Author
  • Experience Documenting Software UIs in an Agile Environment

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We protect the platform that runs X and SpaceXSI. We don’t just report issues, we actively look for real risks and exploits in our Kubernetes environments and turn them into durable fixes and tooling. You will secure the platform behind X and SpaceXSI’s infrastructure, products, and workloads. If you know pod and platform security, think in attack paths, and want to build the defenses that make the platform safer at scale, we want to hear from you.

We Value

  • Understanding how Kubernetes can actually be abused, not only how it is configured
  • Shipping practical controls and tooling over writing policy documents
  • Least privilege and defense-in-depth at fleet scale
  • Clear findings and fixes that platform teams can act on
  • Safe, constrained validation that does not put production at risk

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Secure the platform end to end: nodes, clusters, pods, roles, tokens, secrets, service-to-service communication, and the supply chain
  • Find and remediate overprivileged permissions, dangerous pod and workload settings, and escalation paths in operators, admission, networking, identity, and monitoring
  • Assess our own platform the way an adversary would, including container and pod breakout, privilege escalation, and movement across workloads, using safe and constrained validation, then fix what you find
  • Design and build security tooling and automation, including AI-assisted analysis, that catches risky configuration and overprivilege before or after it ships
  • Strengthen identity and secrets handling so workloads receive only the access they need
  • Improve supply-chain security through secure base images, continuous scanning, and related controls
  • Review changes that affect RBAC, operators, ServiceAccounts, network policies, and anything running with elevated privileges
  • Partner with platform and product teams as a security owner, taking problems from identification through rollout
  • Contribute to fleet-wide hardening, policy enforcement, and safer defaults

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years in platform security, Kubernetes security, or offensive security against production infrastructure
  • Deep knowledge of pod and workload security: privileged containers, capabilities, host namespaces, host path mounts, service accounts, RBAC, admission control, and network isolation
  • Working knowledge of identity, secrets, workload identity, service-to-service trust, supply chain, runtime, and cloud access
  • Able to think like an attacker, measure blast radius, and turn the path into a detection, control, or tool
  • Comfortable with operators, custom resources, Helm, and GitOps workflows
  • Able to build or modify security tooling in Go, Python, or Rust when a control needs automation
  • Bonus: Image scanning, SBOMs, secure base images, policy-as-code (Kyverno, OPA), multi-cluster environments, runtime detection, and security testing of customer-facing application
  • Open to working out of one of our offices: Palo Alto, Austin, DC, or New York. 

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience developing AI-driven security tools or integrating AI into security workflows
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes-based environments and securing cloud-native infrastructure
  • Proven ability to drive technical decisions and influence security practices across teams
  • A passion for challenging the status quo and building transformative security solutions
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience working in dynamic, cross-functional teams
  • A sense of humor and adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

$100,000 - $258,000 USD

Job Description:

Shield AI is building intelligent autonomy systems for the defense of service members and civilians. The Hivemind Solutions organization applies Shield AI’s autonomy stack to mission-critical systems across air, maritime, strike, weapons, space, and collaborative autonomy domains.

We are seeking a Director, Operations Analysis to lead a team responsible for turning operational problems into quantitative insights that shape product strategy, engineering priorities, customer engagement, and mission outcomes. This leader will manage and grow a high-performing Operations Analysis team that uses modeling, simulation, wargaming, campaign analysis, and mission-level trade studies to help determine what Hivemind should build, why it matters, and how it performs in realistic operational contexts.

This is a leadership role for someone who can operate at the intersection of autonomy, military operations, mission engineering, modeling and simulation, product strategy, and customer-facing analysis. The right candidate will be technically credible, analytically rigorous, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to translate complex operational questions into clear recommendations for executives, engineers, business development leaders, and government customers.

What you'll do:

  • Lead and manage the Hivemind Solutions Operations Analysis team, including hiring, mentoring, prioritization, performance management, and technical direction.
  • Build an operations analysis capability that directly informs Hivemind product strategy, autonomy roadmap decisions, customer pursuits, and program execution.
  • Define and execute mission analysis, campaign analysis, force-on-force studies, CONOPS evaluations, and operational trade studies across multiple Hivemind product domains.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, Systems Engineering, Business Development, Strategy, and Program teams to translate operational problems into analytical studies and actionable product recommendations.
  • Develop analysis plans that connect mission objectives, operational assumptions, threat environments, system performance, autonomy behaviors, and measurable mission outcomes.
  • Guide the use of tools such as AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, custom simulations, and other modeling environments to evaluate mission effectiveness and operational value.
  • Establish standards for analytical rigor, model credibility, assumption tracking, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty characterization, and communication of results.
  • Create clear, executive-ready briefings that explain what was analyzed, what assumptions were made, what the results mean, and what decisions should follow.
  • Support customer engagements by developing compelling, technically grounded analysis that demonstrates the operational value of Hivemind-enabled systems.
  • Work with engineering teams to identify the autonomy behaviors, system capabilities, interfaces, performance parameters, and test data needed to improve model fidelity.
  • Help shape product requirements by connecting operational outcomes to measurable system and autonomy performance needs.
  • Build reusable analysis frameworks, scenarios, vignettes, and metrics that can scale across programs and domains.
  • Represent the Operations Analysis function in internal technical reviews, roadmap discussions, capture strategy sessions, and customer-facing meetings.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, physics, aerospace, systems engineering, data science, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in operations analysis, mission analysis, modeling and simulation, systems analysis, military analysis, campaign analysis, or related technical domains.
  • 5+ years of experience leading teams, projects, or technical analysis efforts.
  • Experience using modeling and simulation to inform real product, system, program, or operational decisions.
  • Strong understanding of military operations, mission planning, force employment, kill chains, sensing, communications, autonomy, aircraft systems, weapons systems, or related defense concepts.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous operational questions into structured analysis plans, quantitative methods, and decision-quality outputs.
  • Experience working with engineering, product, business development, strategy, or customer-facing teams.
  • Strong technical communication skills, including the ability to brief senior leaders and customers with clarity, confidence, and analytical discipline.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve quickly and analysis must support real business and technical decisions.
  • U.S. citizenship and eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in operations research, engineering, applied mathematics, data science, aerospace, systems engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Experience with AFSIM, NGTS, STK, MATLAB, Python, Cameo, custom simulation environments, or other mission and campaign analysis tools.
  • Experience analyzing autonomous systems, collaborative autonomy, uncrewed aircraft, crewed-uncrewed teaming, electronic warfare, space systems, missile systems, maritime systems, or air combat operations.
  • Experience supporting defense product development, advanced concepts, government capture efforts, experimentation, test planning, or mission engineering.
  • Familiarity with model validation, verification, credibility assessment, sensitivity analysis, design of experiments, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Experience building analysis teams, establishing technical standards, and scaling analytical capabilities across multiple stakeholders or product lines.
  • Prior military, government laboratory, FFRDC/UARC, defense contractor, or aerospace experience.
  • Active U.S. security clearance.

What success looks like:

    In this role, success means the Operations Analysis team becomes a trusted decision engine for Hivemind Solutions. The team’s work should not sit on a shelf. It should shape what we build, how we prioritize, how we explain operational value to customers, and how we make hard trade decisions across product lines.

    A successful manager will build a team that is technically rigorous, operationally grounded, fast-moving, and deeply connected to the business. They will ensure that analysis is not treated as an after-the-fact briefing function, but as a core part of product development, strategy, and customer engagement.

Why this role matters:

    Autonomy changes what is operationally possible, but only if we understand where it creates real mission advantage. The Operations Analysis team helps answer that question. This team connects Hivemind’s technical capabilities to measurable operational outcomes, helping Shield AI make better product decisions and helping customers understand the mission impact of intelligent autonomous systems.

    If you want to lead a team that sits at the center of autonomy, strategy, engineering, and operational decision-making, this role is for you.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Applications are now open for our January cohort - apply here by October 30.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research 
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers 
  • Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK)
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

Across the workstreams, you may be a good fit if you:

  • Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
  • Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic
  • Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics
  • Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
  • Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

Strong candidates may also have:

  • Strong background in a discipline relevant to a specific Fellows workstream (e.g. economics, social sciences, or cybersecurity)
  • Experience in areas of research or engineering related to their workstream

Candidates must be:

  • Fluent in Python programming
  • Available to work full-time on the Fellows program

Our mentors will lead projects in select AI safety research areas, such as:

  • Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.
  • Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
  • Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.
  • Model Internals / Mechanistic Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.
  • AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Division is rapidly reshaping the future of peer-to-peer conflict. We are building the next generation of affordable, collaborative combat aircraft, missiles, and the autonomous software that powers them. As we scale, we are seeking a visionary Air-Vehicle Multidisciplinary Design Analysis and Optimization (MDAO) Engineer to join our fast-growing team. You will be instrumental in driving the rapid development of cutting-edge weapon systems by integrating and optimizing across the entire design lifecycle. This role is for an engineer who challenges traditional silos between conceptual design, preliminary development, and detailed engineering, bringing together diverse discipline experts to form cohesive, multi-fidelity workflows.

 

 

 

 

We're looking for someone who understands that models are not just for analysis, but are critical tools for informing every stage of product development – from early design decisions to operational sustainment. Your expertise will bridge the gap between engineering analysis, hardware, and software development, ensuring our modeling and tooling choices directly contribute to delivering mission-critical systems to our customers.

 

 

The ideal candidate possesses a strong and broad foundation in computational engineering analysis, adept at modeling both steady-state and transient phenomena. You will integrate disciplinary models (e.g., controls, guidance, mission systems, 6DOF simulations, subsystems, manufacturing) earlier into design iterations. Leveraging commercial MDAO frameworks, you will automate engineering workflows, pioneer advanced methods like Uncertainty Quantification (UQ), and proficiently apply cutting-edge AI tools to accelerate and optimize MDAO processes. Experience with CAD scripting (e.g., Engineering Sketch Pad) for parameterized geometry, operational analysis codes, and a deep understanding of error and uncertainty in modeling complex systems are highly desirable.

 

 

If you are a highly skilled MDAO practitioner ready to leverage your expertise to revolutionize defense capabilities, this role is for you.

 

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

 

  • Lead MDAO Initiatives: Collaborate with air-vehicle design and analysis disciplines and technical leadership across AD&S programs to define and execute critical trade studies, building robust, data-driven workflows using commercial MDAO frameworks.
  • Strategic Development: Work with the AD&S Engineering Tools Lead to shape the strategic roadmap for MDAO capabilities, deploy multi-fidelity workflows across programs, and document available resources.
  • Geometry Generation: Design and implement robust, parameterized, watertight, CAD-based scripted geometry models to enable multidisciplinary analysis and ensure consistent results.
  • Accelerate Design Insights: Drive the earlier integration of disciplinary models into the design process, providing rich data to inform critical tradespace decisions.
  • Pioneer Methodologies: Develop and apply cutting-edge MDAO methods and models to significantly increase the efficiency and effectiveness of AD&S teams.
  • Apply AI to MDAO: Innovate and deploy Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions within MDAO workflows to enhance efficiency and discovery.
  • Optimize Workflows: Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and recommend solutions to continuously improve multi-fidelity workflows.
  • Execute Advanced Analyses: Assemble and run automated MDAO workflows, Design of Experiments (DOE), optimizations, sensitivity analyses, and Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) for AD&S programs.
  • Mentor & Guide: Direct discipline experts on efficient methods and approaches to create "MDAO-hardened" models and tools suitable for robust multi-fidelity workflows.
  • Document & Train: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation and training materials for new and experienced technical experts utilizing MDAO technologies across AD&S.

 

 

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

  • Bachelor's or higher degree from an accredited program in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
  • 8+ years of experience in aircraft and/or missile design and analysis.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing MDAO methods, demonstrating broad understanding across multiple engineering disciplines, such as: Cost, Configuration Design, Mass Properties, Lethality, Structures, Propulsion, Aerodynamics, Vehicle Performance, Thermal Management, Power Management, Systems Engineering, Survivability, Operational Analysis, Mission Systems, Avionics, Launch Systems, and GNC (Guidance, Navigation & Controls).
  • Proven experience in developing and deploying MDAO workflows and toolsets.
  • Expertise in applying optimization, sensitivity analysis, Uncertainty Quantification (UQ), and Design of Experiments (DOE) methods.
  • Demonstrable ability to apply large language models and/or develop AI models to enhance or accelerate engineering processes and tasks with measurable efficiency improvements.
  • Proficiency in higher-level scripting languages (Python, MATLAB) within a version-controlled environment (preferably Git), with exposure to compiled languages (C, C++, FORTRAN).
  • Strong collaborative spirit and a desire to contribute to methods development and process workflows in a team setting.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, particularly in organizing and presenting complex MDAO insights to inform stakeholders quickly and concisely.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Secret security clearance and Special Access Program (SAP) eligibility.

 

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

  • Advanced degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
  • Experience developing MDAO workflows and toolsets using commercial MDAO framework software (e.g., ModeFRONTIER/VOLTA, Siemens HEEDS, or similar environments).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Top Secret security clearance and SAP eligibility.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Logistics Manager to join our rapidly growing team in Quincy, MA. In this role, you are responsible for overseeing all global logistics operations supporting Undersea Reconnaissance and Strike events and shipments. You will ensure the secure, compliant, and timely transport and storage of sensitive equipment, assets, and materials in alignment with U.S. government regulations and defense contracting standards. The ideal candidate has extensive knowledge of international logistics services and capabilities, defense trade compliance (ITAR/EAR), and the complexities of moving controlled equipment across borders for temporary and permanent export.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Logistics Execution

  • Plan, manage, and execute logistics for all shipping to and from URS locations.
  • Generate commercial invoices and packing lists for the export of items internationally.
  • Work with international trade compliance to ensure proper jurisdiction classification on exports
  • Oversee the secure transport and storage of sensitive equipment, prototypes, and display assets, ensuring compliance with defense sector requirements.
  • Develop logistics playbooks and contingency strategies for mission-critical event timelines.
  • Manage export/import documentation, ATA Carnets, customs declarations, and temporary imports.

Transportation & Vendor Management

  • Manage freight forwarders, customs brokers and specialized logistics service providers.
  • Select and oversee logistics service partners with proven defense industry and government clearance capabilities.

Budgeting & Cost Control

  • Track and analyze costs related to freight, warehousing, customs, duties, and special handling.
  • Drive cost optimization while ensuring compliance and operational excellence.

Risk Management & Process Improvement

  • Develop and implement KPIs for on-time delivery, compliance accuracy, and cost performance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, or related field (master’s preferred).

  • Knowledge of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, U.S. export/import controls and import/exports controls of various global markets.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Vehicle Management Systems (VMS) software team, which is part of Anduril's Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) division, develops flight computer vehicle software for small drones (Group 1–3).

Are you passionate about avionics and flight software? Join us in refining the foundation for a common Vehicle Management System (VMS) that can be used across Group 1–3 UAVs. The team is enhancing the current Altius VMS to support modularity, clean abstractions, and faster new-aircraft development cycles—laying the groundwork for scalable, reusable flight software across the TRS product line.

The right person for this role has experience in flight control software and embedded Linux or RTOS development. Joining early means you’ll directly shape how we scale—both in the volume of drones we build and the breadth of missions they can fly. Our engineers move quickly from simulation to flight and thrive on solving real-world problems that matter.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Flight Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing the embedded software that powers Anduril’s aircraft while working alongside a team of engineers with a diverse set of backgrounds and skills. Anduril has a collaborative culture with plenty of opportunities for ownership. As an early member of the team, your decisions today will have a large impact on the company now and into the future, as well as on our customers.

You’ll own sections of the flight stack end-to-end — from device drivers and middleware integration to control law implementation, test automation, and flight validation. Expect to work closely with GNC, hardware, manufacturing, and operations teams, lead technical design reviews, and mentor junior engineers. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on real-world engineering constraints and wants to see the code they ship fly on mission-critical systems.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and implement vehicle control systems.
  • Develop embedded software for pre-emptible Linux or RTOS applications.
  • Develop device drivers, protocols, and APIs for aircraft sensors.
  • Integrate new features and sensors into flight controller software.
  • Integrate guidance and control algorithms with the flight software stack.
  • Create Software-In-The-Loop (SITL) and Hardware-In-The-Loop (HITL) test fixtures and automation.
  • Analyze flight test results and iterate quickly on fixes and improvements.
  • Support device manufacturing efforts, debugging, and production-level test.
  • Support operational aircraft deployments and field troubleshooting.
  • Mentor junior engineers and help improve team engineering practices and test infrastructure.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4+ years of C++ or Rust programming experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Direct experience with embedded software or other safety-critical systems.
  • Background in low-level embedded software architecture, design and development.
  • Low-level device driver development experience; familiarity with both microcontrollers and application processors.
  • Comfortable with typical embedded systems tools, compilers, debuggers, and IDEs.
  • Familiarity with communications busses and protocols such as CAN, CAN FD, UART/RS232/RS422/RS485, SPI, QSPI, I2C, Ethernet, etc.
  • Strong debugging skills, comfortable using instrumentation such as oscilloscopes and protocol analyzers.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of C++ or Rust programming experience creating clean, efficient, and reliable code.
  • Strong vehicle systems and avionics design knowledge.
  • Experience building flight stacks or working with PX4/ArduPilot or proprietary autopilots.
  • Familiarity with control systems, state estimation, and guidance algorithms.
  • Bias toward delivery and rapid iteration to discover the right engineering investments.
  • Willingness to take calculated risks and full accountability for outcomes.
  • Passion for solving real-world problems quickly and effectively.
  • Track record of designing, building, and delivering useful software to users — we want to hear war stories!
  • Experience with SITL/HITL frameworks, CI for embedded systems, and creating reproducible test environments.

We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. 

  • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

  • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

ABOUT THE JOB 

We are seeking a Senior Configuration Design Engineer for our Air Dominance & Strike hardware engineering organization. As a Senior Engineer, you will own the architectural configuration, scoping, and optimization methodology for our advanced Group 5 Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) and missile programs. You will serve as a technical leader, defining engineering processes, mentoring junior engineers, and directly partnering with Chief Engineers and customers to translate complex mission requirements into revolutionary, buildable aircraft architectures.

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

  • Lead the end-to-end conceptual design process for complex UAV and missile platforms, including configuration trade studies, mission analysis, and architecture selection.
  • Define and mature aircraft sizing methodologies, deploying parametric modeling and design optimization tools (such as MATLAB, Isight, HEEDS, and NX Unigraphics) to establish robust design paths.
  • Drive the design of Outer Mold Lines (OML) and Inner Mold Lines (IML), establishing the geometric standards for downstream analysis teams (CFD, FEA, CEM).
  • Serve as the main technical decision-maker for early-stage pursuits, shaping concept white papers, customer proposals, and technology roadmaps in partnership with Chief Engineers.
  • Apply engineering intuition and expertise to evaluate configuration alternatives for low-observable (RF/IR signature) survivability, propulsion integration, and structural feasibility.
  • Manage high-level vehicle trade studies including engine selection, control effector layout, fuel systems, weapons integration, and mass properties.
  • Mentor and develop junior configuration and design engineers, establishing standards for CAD modeling, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and design release.
  • Interface directly with integrated product teams (IPTs), suppliers, and military customers to present configuration concepts and resolve challenging design problems.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 8+ years of experience in conceptual or preliminary design of aerospace systems, with a track record of technical leadership on UAS, military aircraft, or advanced missile programs.
  • Expert-level proficiency in 3D parametric CAD modeling, advanced surfacing, and lofting (Siemens NX preferred, CATIA, or Creo).
  • Extensive experience leading multi-disciplinary design teams and trade studies (aerodynamics, structures, propulsion, mass properties, and systems integration).
  • Deep understanding of system architecture, mission requirements, and full product development lifecycles.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to write technical proposals and present design solutions to leadership and customers.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret Security Clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Expert knowledge in design-for-survivability, low-observable (LO) shaping, and RF/IR signature reduction.
  • Advanced experience in building surrogate models, optimization workflows, or leveraging machine learning tools to accelerate conceptual design cycles.
  • Experience with rapid prototyping, flight testing, and hardware-in-the-loop development environments.
  • Active U.S. Secret or Top Secret Security Clearance.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance & Strike Electromechanical Engineers are responsible for the mechanical packaging, interconnect architecture, and structural integration of avionics, power systems, and electro-optical payloads across Group 5 aircrafts and our high-speed missiles. The team owns the full development lifecycle—from concept through qualification and flight operations—delivering rugged, high-performance electromechanical systems optimized for Size, Weight, Power, and Cost (SWaP-C).

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Design flight-critical enclosures, chassis, and mechanical packaging for high-density circuit card assemblies, battery systems, electro-optical payloads, and cable/harness assemblies.
  • Collaborate with electrical engineers to inform PCBA layout, define connector configurations, manage keep-out zones, route harnesses, and establish thermal and grounding interfaces.
  • Create detailed 3D models, drawing packages, and GD&T and tolerance stack-up analyses to ensure designs are optimized for assembly, serviceability, and high-yield manufacturing.
  • Conduct hand calculations and structural FEA, working with thermal and fatigue analysts to validate performance before committing to physical hardware.
  • Design hardware to survive aerospace environments—vibration, shock, thermal extremes, moisture, and EMI/EMC—meeting standards such as MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-464/461, and DO-160.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and corrective actions for mechanical, environmental, or manufacturing anomalies found during qualification or flight operations.
  • Support design reviews (PDR/CDR) and drive execution of engineering deliverables across distributed, cross-functional teams including systems, hardware, software, manufacturing, test, and supply chain.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • B.S. or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in electronics packaging and/or electromechanical systems design in aerospace, defense, automotive, or robotics.
  • Direct experience designing hardware to MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-464/461 environmental and EMI/EMC standards.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD (Siemens NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for complex surface modeling, enclosure packaging, and harness routing.
  • Understanding of advanced manufacturing processes including CNC machining, sheet metal fabrication, casting, injection molding, and 3D printing, with hands-on prototyping experience.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills across multi-site, multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Extensive experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter.
  • Familiarity with eCAD tools (Altium, Cadence Allegro) and harness design software (Siemens Capital, Zuken E3).
  • Practical understanding of bare-board PCB manufacturing, high-density interconnect (HDI) stackups, and SMT assembly standards (IPC-A-610/J-STD-001).
  • Advanced FEA and thermal simulation experience with tools such as Ansys Mechanical, Ansys Icepak, FloTHERM, or Ansys Sherlock.
  • Experience designing battery modules/packs or precision-aligned electro-optical/sensor payloads.
  • Active Top Secret DoD clearance.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is fielding the next generation of Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs) to tackle the extremely challenging industry demands of seabed exploration. Anduril has brought to the market a unique, ultra-long-range, full-ocean-depth platform, and a completely refreshed maritime vehicle and flexible manufacturing architecture that scales from "large" to "extra-large" vehicle sizes. Today, Anduril is executing on multi-million-dollar contracts while simultaneously performing Robot-as-a-Service (RaaS) AUV operations.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our growing team in Quonset, RI. In this role, you will be responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge Autonomous Underwater Vehicles. This responsibility includes Design for Manufacturability, tool design & selection, process creation & optimization, vendor sourcing & interaction, quality planning, and work documentation associated with the hardware that the Manufacturing Engineer owns.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own a portion or all of the manufacturing value chain for a certain product or set of products
  • Write documentation required for successfully manufacturing their hardware at scale, such as work instructions, quality plans, inspection requirements, etc.
  • Develop process flows, breaking down large, complex assemblies into a logical part flow of subassemblies and sub-processes
  • Work with contract manufacturers across various disciplines (PCBA fab, metal/plastic manufacturing, assembly, etc.) to develop repeatable, sustained processes for quick-turn development as well as at-scale production
  • Work with technicians and other engineers in a hands-on fashion building prototype hardware
  • Develop novel tooling solutions for fabrication and assembly of structural parts
  • Contribute to end-customer hardware mechanical or electrical design, including interconnects, board fabrication and inspection, etc.
  • Frequent travel between Quonset/Quincy facilities is expected to facilitate production scale-up activities across both sites

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Degree in a technical field such as engineering, math, or a hard science
  • 3+ years of experience in a relevant field, preferably manufacturing or design of electromechanical hardware
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver electromechanical hardware to spec in a start-up environment
  • Personal experience physically manufacturing hardware via any means (machining, fabrication, soldering, assembly, etc.). Work on personal or extracurricular projects is a plus
  • Extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in sub-sea robotics (AUVs, UUVs, underwater sensors/equipment)
  • Experience working with electrical systems up to 400VDc
  • Subsea cable splicing or fabrication experience
  • Experience with pressure vessels and/or pressure systems/equipment
  • Prior experience working with JIRA, Teamcenter (PLM), NetSuite (ERP) or equivalents
  • Experience with large scale low volume / high mix manufacturing
  • Has a never-ending sense of urgency and enthusiasm

ABOUT THE TEAM
The Air Dominance and Strike MRB Mechanical Engineering Team supports the production, sustainment, and airworthiness of Group 5 air vehicles and missile platforms. The team is focused on keeping fielded and in-production systems flying — evaluating nonconforming hardware, driving Material Review Board (MRB) dispositions, resolving production issues, and ensuring mechanical subsystems meet performance and safety requirements throughout their operational lifecycle. The team works at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, and quality to maintain the pace of production without compromising airworthiness.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Coordinate with the manufacturing and engineering teams for all of Mechanical Subsystems, including: propulsion, hydraulic systems, fuel systems, landing gear, and systems integration
  • Evaluate nonconforming mechanical hardware and components on fielded and in-production Group 5 air vehicles, and determine engineering dispositions that restore airworthiness and function
  • Generate clear, traceable MRB dispositions — including rework instructions and repair solutions — for mechanical subsystems, actuation, and structural-mechanical interfaces
  • Review and interpret CAD models, 2D drawings, GD&T, and tolerance stack-ups to assess fit, function, and manufacturability impacts of non-conformances
  • Identify acceptable alternate components for obsolete parts
  • Perform structural and mechanical analysis (stress, deflection, fatigue) using hand calculations and FEA tools to substantiate dispositions and repairs
  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action efforts for recurring non-conformances and production escapes on mechanical hardware
  • Partner daily with Manufacturing, Quality, Design Engineering, and Supply Chain to resolve build issues and keep production flowing without compromising safety or performance
  • Build prototypes and test fixtures in the field or on the production floor; analyze failures and feed learnings back into design
  • Travel to vendor, production, and test sites as needed to support hardware builds and troubleshoot issues directly
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers on MRB discipline, mechanical fundamentals, and cross-functional coordination

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.S. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of mechanical engineering experience, including direct experience evaluating nonconformances and dispositioning hardware in a production, depot, or maintenance environment
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD tools (CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, or SolidWorks) and strong command of GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis
  • Ability to perform structural and mechanical analysis (stress, deflection, fatigue) using hand calculations and FEA tools (ANSYS, NASTRAN, or equivalent)
  • Understanding of manufacturing methods relevant to mechanical hardware (machining, sheet metal, fasteners, actuation, 3D printing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to produce clear, technically sound disposition and repair documentation under schedule pressure
  • Self-driven with strong autonomy and adaptability in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct MRB signature/delegated authority on a production aerospace program
  • Experience with Siemens NX/Teamcenter or other PLM systems
  • Experience integrating electrical and mechanical subsystems into advanced air vehicles
  • Familiarity with military airworthiness and certification processes (Military Commercial Derivative Aircraft certification, FAA STC, Military Airworthiness Certification)
  • Experience with FMEA and other risk assessment methodologies
  • Hands-on experience in an aircraft manufacturing, depot repair, or sustainment environment
  • Broad experience across a range of aircraft or missile programs

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an NPI Engineer with an Electrical, Electromechanical, Mechatronic, Process Engineering or Design for Manufacturing background to join our growing Dive-XL team in Quonset Point, RI. The NPI Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that new products and/or new product generations are launched successfully and consistently across our global manufacturing sites. You will own technical knowledge transfer and act as the critical bridge between the design team and production, from the initial NPI/pilot site to rate production facilities, by architecting and executing a bi-directional exchange of operational manufacturing, product and process knowledge. Your primary mission is to identify, mitigate, and resolve process bottlenecks and project dependencies, and own knowledge transfers between production sites.

The right person for this role can demonstrate past ownership on solving operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. Background in the generation of DFM, DFA, DFX design concepts is an added plus that will increase velocity of knowledge share.

This person will be flexible to provide both solution proposals and support wherever needed to ensure products are built and tested under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the introduction of configuration management decisions in the production system at Quonset and the follow-on impacts across multiple sites
  • Champion the DFM/DFX/DFA of existing production designs into the development pipeline
  • Collaborate with leadership on to prevent engineering team scope creep to facilitate the on-schedule release of new and/or improved designs
  • Design, implement, and continuously improve a standardized knowledge transfer framework between multiple production sites and multiple new product development site, including checklists, templates, communication plans, and stage-gate reviews.
  • Coordinate cross-functional activities, ensuring engineering, supply chain, quality, and production deliverables are completed on time.
  • For assigned NPI programs, serve as the primary point of contact of the Quonset site for all knowledge transfer activities.
  • Deeply embed with the Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality and Manufacturing teams from early development through the initial production run to gain expert-level product and process knowledge. Lead the effort to capture this knowledge for future transfer.
  • Facilitate Cross-Site collaborations by organizing and leading regular communication forums, technical deep dives, and virtual reviews between Engineering and Operations teams at all involved sites, ensuring alignment and de-conflicting issues.
  • Mentor and develop key engineers and technicians at receiving sites, empowering them to become self-sufficient subject matter experts for their product lines.
  • Proactively break down "not invented here" barriers and foster a company-wide culture of open communication, shared learning, and standardization.
  • Manage engineering change workflows (ECR/ECO) affecting manufacturing of transferred technology, including phase-in/out timelines
  • Track risks, issues, and actions with mitigation and escalation when needed.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in a manufacturing or product integration environment, with at least 3 years directly involved in New Product Introduction (NPI).
  • Demonstrated experience leading the transfer of a product or process from one manufacturing site to another.
  • Deep technical credibility and hands-on experience with modern manufacturing processes and quality systems (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, AS9100).
  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills; ability to influence and lead teams without direct reporting authority.
  • A natural teacher and mentor with a passion for documentation and process improvement.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally as required.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance & Strike Propulsion Integration team is responsible for designing and integrating advanced hardware for Group 5 air vehicles and across missile platforms. Air Dominance & Strike Propulsion Engineers own the full development lifecycle, from concept generation, to integration and flight test, ensuring high-performance, resilient, and scalable mechanical systems that meet the demands of complex, contested environments.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Serve as a lead or key contributor in the selection, architecting, and integration of aircraft engines, engine components, and engine controls on unmanned air vehicles (UAVs).
  • Design, fabricate, and test prototype components and control systems.
  • Plan, instrument, and execute tests of aircraft propulsion systems.
  • Coordinate with engine vendors, develop strategic partnerships, and manage development projects.
  • Lead or support critical hardware demonstrations with customers as needed.
  • Critical member of team supporting CAD design for inlet / exhaust shaping, surfaces and structures.
  • Travel to test sites as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Electrical Engineering.
  • 15+ years of propulsion engineering experience on air vehicles (manned or unmanned).
  • Professional experience with jet engines in the 250-20,000 lbf thrust class.
  • Mastery of engine cycle decks and thermodynamic modeling; ability to influence engine OEM design decisions to match vehicle requirements.
  • Served as the Chief Engineer or ultimate technical authority on a major propulsion program, defining technology roadmaps and architectural baselines.
  • Experience identifying and selecting strategic propulsion suppliers, managing critical OEM relationships, and establishing qualified supply chains.
  • Experience defining comprehensive propulsion test programs (including static / ground off wing testing, qualification, acceptance, flight-test readiness) and troubleshooting system level anomalies.
  • Experience advising executive leadership on technical risks, representing the company to key customers / government agencies, and mentoring mid-to-senior level engineers.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in NX / Teamcenter, Python, MATLAB, IADs.
  • Hands-on experience with jet engine testing including test practices, instrumentation, and data processing.
  • Previous work experience at a jet engine OEM or supplier, with a deep understanding of engine performance trade-offs.
  • Knowledge and experience working with FADEC, Engine Management Systems (EMS), or equivalent aircraft engine control systems.
  • Experience procuring parts and working in a machine shop. Working knowledge of machine safety and shop safety protocols.
  • Active U.S. Top Secret security clearance.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Copperhead team is responsible for the product development of high speed small diameter undersea autunomous vehicles to support across critical commercial and defense mission sets. You'll operate in a fast-paced environment where small empowered teams move with urgency to deliver cutting-edge maritime capabilities from concept to deployment in months, not years. We bias toward action, embrace ambiguity, and expect technical program managers to drive execution with minimal bureaucracy — because the mission and the warfighter can't wait.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a motivated Program Manager that is inspired to work within an energetic, creative, and innovative team that is passionate about subsea robotics and exploring the open ocean. We work in a highly dynamic environment where collaboration and complex idea sharing are a way of life.

Our next Program Manager will be owning a high profile Copperhead product out of Quincy, MA.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Oversee a major program and associated development activities within Anduril’s Copperhead product family.
  • Manage the execution of customer-funded efforts related to employment and advancement of a vehicle in the Copperhead product family and ensure alignment with company and division growth objectives.
  • Lead an immediate team of 3-6 engineer focused on program requirements, system architecture definition, design, build, test and execution to successfully deliver capabilities to customers.
  • Develop, run and maintain Cost - Schedule - Performance of direct funded program for a program in concert with a Navy program office and across Navy stakeholders on the program.
  • Support detailed scoping and planning efforts to drive the design, build and deployment of a vehicle within the Copperhead portfolio.
  • Develop and maintain effective working relationships with critical service and program office stakeholders to ensure successful milestone completions and drive the program from prototyping into production phases.
  • Collaborate closely with growth and engineering leads to develop and execute coordinated approaches to new business opportunities in which defense customers require products from across Anduril.
  • Lead formal testing efforts by identifying strategic initiatives, estimating resources needed, and supporting mobilization logistics. Coordinate test execution with 3rd party vendors and partners.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, trust, open communications, customer focus, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Travel to support customer meetings and testing approximately ~15-30% of the time

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • The ideal candidate will be a proven strategic program leader who has demonstrated experience in leading product development, both hardware and software, with an emphasis on the US Navy as customer.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in defense acquisitions, with a history of zero-to-one defense program growth a plus
  • Experience in the technical, programmatic, and operational challenges of developing and deploying autonomous weapon systems
  • Experience with government business development, government contract structures, government proposal processes
  • Demonstrated ability to organize, prioritize and manage multiple tasks and concurrent projects. Anduril Maritime’s capabilities are in great demand and the PM must be able to successfully coordinate a portfolio of multiple priorities and development activities
  • Demonstrated high-energy, high-ownership leader who will drive performance and exhibit strong management skills with a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, highly entrepreneurial, and creative environment, and be able to build, adapt, and implement new and innovative approaches to market
  • Excellent writing, communication skills with experience briefing senior executives and customers
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Top Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7+ years of relevant Program Management, Acquisitions or Resource Sponsor experience in the government and/or private sector
  • Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or related field and a passion for robotics and/or system development
  • Intimate understanding of government contracting, fielding, and requirements generation for the purposes of transitioning prototype capabilities to production.

Data Science and Engineering (DSE) is a key pillar of Netflix’s data-driven strategy, leveraging data, analytics, experimentation, models, and consumer insights to inform decisions. We are committed to using data to inform our decision-making as we work toward our mission. This involves curating data across various domains, such as Growth, Finance, Product, Content, and Studio. All of this data collection and curation is made possible thanks to Netflix’s talented Data Engineers, who bring this data to life.


About Data Engineering:

Data Engineering at Netflix involves building systems to process data efficiently and modeling data to power analytics. These solutions range from batch data pipelines that bring business metrics to life, to real-time processing services that integrate with our core product features. Data Engineers benefit from a strong understanding of large distributed systems on which our data solutions rely. Candidates should have experience across several of these skill sets and depth in at least one area. Effective communication skills are important, as you will collaborate with business, engineering, and data science teams to foster a culture of learning.


Member Data Engineering

This team creates the data products that help measure this experience, track key metrics, and support innovation decisions through A/B testing.  You will partner closely with engineering teams to refine the client and server logging that serves as a foundation for our analytic datasets, and work closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers using this data to identify new opportunities and test out new ideas.

About the Developer Platform Teams

The Infrastructure Engineering Organization at Netflix has teams focusing on a number of different areas including: modernization, resilience & reliability tooling, internal application interface development, improving the technical health of systems, and collecting and reporting on the metrics that help Netflix quantify and improve developer productivity.


At the moment we are hiring for following teams:


1. Health Integrity of the Paved Road (HIPR)


The Health Integrity of the Paved Road (HIPR) team is (another) one of three pillars in Netflix's System Health, Validation & Insights Platform group. The Paved Road empowers Netflix engineers with the tools and context they need to make well-informed, responsible decisions in pursuit of Netflix’s mission to Entertain the World while maximizing our engineering leverage and scale. The HIPR team's mission is to enable Netflix engineers go (and stay) on the Paved Road effortlessly.

We do that by:

  • Defining what healthy looks like through health primitives, measuring it it, and surfacing it to the right teams at the right time
  • Injecting those primitives as a context ready to be consumed both by humans and agents at the points of code generation and decision making

2. Change Systems


The Change Systems team builds and owns the platform infrastructure that powers large-scale change automation across Netflix's engineering organization.   • Building the dependency graph and service catalog systems that give engineers complete visibility into the blast radius and impact of their changes
  • Creating the operational backbone for large-scale code migrations, modernization campaigns, and fleet-wide updates with built-in safety guards and rollback capabilities
  • Enabling GenAI-powered code transformation and agentic tooling to work safely and effectively at Netflix scale, reducing friction and accelerating development velocity

We are seeking experienced Software Engineers who are passionate about writing software that will help other engineers write software. This role requires demonstrated experience scaling services and applications to serve hundreds of users and thousands of requests per minute. Engineers in this job will interact with customers and product managers to ensure that the team is delivering the tools and features needed by Netflix. Writing design documents, driving changes across teams and organizations, and ensuring the reliability and success of productivity tools is a significant part of this role. The tools and services delivered by engineers in this role will span multiple parts of the stack (from persistence and data layers through business logic and service APIs to front-end user UX) so familiarity with each of those areas is required, though focus, experience, and expertise may be concentrated on one layer.

AI agents are only as useful as the context and capabilities they can access. Work IQ connects agents to workplace knowledge and actions across Microsoft 365 and connected systems through a consistent, governed interface.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution for the platform underlying Work IQ MCP (Model Context Protocol) and its provider ecosystem, with an emphasis on retrieval and its connection to federated MCP servers. You will shape how agents discover and retrieve relevant evidence across indexed content and live sources, and how providers bring capabilities into Work IQ while supporting domain fidelity, security, reliability, and performance.

This is a deeply technical, cross-organizational individual contributor role. You will operate autonomously through ambiguity across evolving product areas, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement. You will translate complex and evolving product, architecture, customer, and ecosystem needs into clear decisions and executable plans. You will lead through influence across organizational boundaries, delegating and coordinating work through teams and individuals outside your direct reporting structure while driving follow-through on commitments and maintaining end-to-end accountability for product outcomes.

You will also work directly with customers, developers, partners, and consuming teams to understand their scenarios and translate feedback into platform improvements that benefit multiple consumers.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

  • Set platform direction and drive execution. Own and evolve the strategy and prioritized roadmap for Work IQ’s shared platform and provider ecosystem, translating customer, developer, and business needs into scalable capabilities and clear investment priorities while driving execution through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead retrieval as a product. Define product requirements and success measures for relevance, source coverage, freshness, citations, provenance, and structured evidence used by consuming agents.

  • Shape retrieval and federation experiences. Partner with engineering and applied science to define how indexed retrieval and live federated sources work together, including source selection, result normalization, ranking, latency, reliability, and partial-failure experiences.

  • Connect retrieval to downstream experiences. Establish requirements for source references, discovery, and integration patterns that enable agents to move reliably from retrieved evidence to authorized fetches or actions.

  • Build a scalable provider ecosystem. Define provider onboarding, capability and schema discovery, compatibility expectations, lifecycle management, and readiness requirements that support reusable platform experiences.

  • Make enterprise trust and operability foundational. Partner with engineering, security, and governance teams to define requirements related to identity, authorization, tenant policy, auditability, observability, reliability, and controlled rollout.

  • Lead through influence across organizational boundaries. Delegate and coordinate work across provider, consumer, product, and engineering teams and individuals outside your direct reporting structure.
